guesses.reason: Short dense coat with a brown mackerel tabby pattern on the back and sides plus a white muzzle, chest, belly, and paws is the classic random-bred tabby-and-white look.
The bold dark tabby striping and sturdy medium build hint at American Shorthair-type ancestry, though the slim leggy frame argues against a purebred.
The wedge-shaped head with large upright ears and lean, athletic body resemble a European Shorthair type.

breed.appearance: A lean, leggy young adult shorthair with a brown mackerel tabby coat of dark vertical stripes over a warm gray-brown base on the back, sides, and upper legs, and a long, upright tail ringed in dark bands that ends in a black tip curling forward. The face has a tabby cap and cheeks with a white blaze running from the forehead down over a pink nose and white muzzle, a small dark speck on the left side of the muzzle, large round golden-yellow eyes, and tall triangular ears with pinkish insides. The chest, belly, and all four paws are bright white, with the front legs white up to the elbow and the hind legs showing white socks below tabby-striped upper legs.
breed.fun_fact: Tabby-and-white cats like Burt come in a nearly endless variety of patterns, so no two are ever exactly alike!
